subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 4 1 7 9 2 2 7 9 9 9 4 7 7 8 9 1 8 6 2 1 2 2 8 (Right)

How many such even digits are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 4 1 7 9 2 2 7 9 9 9 4 7 7 8 9 1 8 6 2 1 2 2 8 (Right)

Now,

Even digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Even — Odd [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f56e20d8b8f15447561af8c7eb7219aa58df62a8ba726fb8da4b7f44750d8fe.png] Thus, there are two even digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
